description.value:
Two or more of a maestro's pawns (or the maestro and at least one pawn) are within melee reach of this creature, so it's off-guard to that maestro and their pawns. Applied and removed automatically by the Maestro module as tokens move; see DESIGN.md §5.6.

(verify) the module doesn't yet apply the off-guard condition itself — that needs the core PF2e off-guard condition's UUID, which isn't available in this environment. The GM should apply off-guard by hand until that's filled in.
